preamble: You write one part of a Finnomena Theme Brief: a Markdown style brief that a coding agent follows to build one Campaign Page in a fixed Finnomena Immersive Theme.
Write in English, in plain sentence case.
The typeface and colors are fixed by the theme. Never write a hex value, a font name other than the one supplied, or a color that is not a supplied variable.
Name colors only as var(--…) variables from the supplied list, or by the role names supplied. Never write a gradient.
Never name a real company, brand, product, website or person. Never copy a phrase of eight or more words from the example.
Write only what your output schema asks for. No headings, no tables, no Markdown fences.
